newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Gaddafi asks Tunisian businessmen to invest.
newsitem.headline: Gaddafi asks Tunisian businessmen to invest.

text.p: Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi on Thursday urged Tunisian businessmen to invest in his country.

"Any Tunisian is free to establish a plant or exploit a farm in Libya and whoever has a knowledge of fisheries can also go there. He must call on me if he finds any opposition," Gaddafi told a gathering of 140 businessmen in Tunis.
Gaddafi, on an official visit, said the two countries would soon sign into law a draft bill on investment.
He also said he wanted Tunisian businessmen to invest in petrochemicals, iron and steel industries.
